description: Transparent Blender renders of the 43 interpreted Best catalog models. Original Matrix cut-outs take precedence for original furniture.

projection.anchor: Layout origin: Three (col, height, row) maps to Blender (col, -row, height).
projection.rotation: view.rotation = item.rot; Blender Z and Three Y rotate by -rot*pi/2.

render.shadows: Self shadows only; no baked floor shadow.
